variant='''def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
 hit_rows={r for r,c in markers if c==0 or c==w-1}; hit_cols={c for r,c in markers if r==0 or r==h-1}
 for r in hit_rows: out[r]=[1]*w
 for c in hit_cols:
  for r in range(h): out[r][c]=1
 seen=set()
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if grid[r][c]!=2 or (r,c) in seen: continue
   st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
   while st:
    i,j=st.pop(); comp.append((i,j))
    for ni,nj in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)):
     if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and grid[ni][nj]==2 and (ni,nj) not in seen: seen.add((ni,nj)); st.append((ni,nj))
   rs=[i for i,j in comp]; cs=[j for i,j in comp]
   r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
   hit=any(i in hit_rows or j in hit_cols for i,j in comp)
   vertical_only=any(j in hit_cols for i,j in comp) and not any(i in hit_rows for i,j in comp)
   edge_only=all(j in (c0,c1) for i,j in comp if j in hit_cols)
   if hit and not (vertical_only and edge_only and (c1-c0+1)>(r1-r0+1)):
    for i,j in comp: out[i][j]=1
 return out
'''
task_file.write_text(variant)
